items.title: Today
items.text: we keep growing thanks to those who choose us again and recommend us
HousySpace was born five years ago from one very simple conviction: **people must always be at the centre of every property transaction.**
After years of experience in the sector, we knew its dynamics and demands well — and we also knew what, in our view, could be done differently.
We wanted to create a space where closeness was genuine, attention was truly personalised, and every client felt that their concerns were ours too.

That is how HousySpace was born. Not with the intention of being just another agency, but to build a practice true to our way of understanding this profession: with empathy, honesty, dedication and a commitment that goes far beyond closing a deal.
Because behind every property there is a story, an important decision and people who place their trust in us.

And few things satisfy us as much as sharing the excitement of someone finding their first home, helping a family start a new chapter, or knowing that we have guided a client towards the right decision.
Five years on, we keep growing thanks to that same philosophy and, above all, to the trust of those who choose us again and recommend us.
Our philosophy
Real estate consultants, not just salespeople.
We advise you on how to do it, whether it makes sense for you and when the right moment is, and we make sure everything you do is correct and safe.

items.title: No surprises
items.text: Thorough due diligence on the property before buying or selling.
**Always one mile more:** everything a real estate agency does, and everything else that is needed.
How we work
We do not aim to manage the greatest number of properties.
We prefer to give each client the time, attention and effort they deserve, offering a **close, transparent and truly personalised** service.
The journey together
We are an agency that understands success in a simple way: **doing our job well** and ensuring our clients feel satisfied with the journey we have shared.
From start to finish
**We are passionate about what we do.** We commit fully to every transaction, find solutions when difficulties arise, and support our clients from the very first moment to the end of the process.
Partnerships with sector professionals
Surrounding ourselves with the best is also part of our philosophy.
Over the years we have built a network of professionals specialised in legal advice, architecture, interior design, renovations and other areas related to property and assets.
Every partnership grows from experience, trust and a shared way of understanding work: **offering a close, rigorous and committed service to each client.**
Our criterion is simple: **we work with professionals we would trust ourselves.**

Thanks to them, we can offer comprehensive solutions and support you far beyond a single property transaction. Because for us, saying «Don't worry, I'll take care of it» means having the people, the knowledge and the will to make it happen.
